# Conclusion {.unnumbered}

This guide has presented the features of the `quarto-cnam-thesis` template following
the *code + output* principle: each syntax is shown exactly as typed, then immediately
rendered in the document. This self-referential approach aims to make the template
self-sufficient as documentation.

## Recommended workflow {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Daily writing cycle

1. **Write in HTML**: `quarto render --profile en --to cnam-thesis-html --no-clean`
   — fast rendering, easy navigation, ideal for proofreading.
2. **Check the PDF** before each {{< acrs csi >}} meeting:
   `quarto render --profile en` — compiles everything and generates the PDF/A-1b.
3. **Version regularly**: commit at least after each writing session, ideally before
   and after each supervision meeting.
4. **Disable comments** before final submission:
   `extensions.quarto-proofread-comments.enabled: false` in `_quarto.yml`.
:::

The template is maintained on GitHub. To report an issue or propose an improvement:
[zinc75/quarto-cnam-thesis](https://github.com/zinc75/quarto-cnam-thesis).
